description: Browses and selects colors from the available palettes.

events.name: tp-color-picker-copy-error
events.description: Emitted when copying the selected color token fails. The detail contains the requested clipboard text, selection metadata and the caught error.
events.detail: { token: string; value: string; error: unknown }

events.name: tp-color-picker-select
events.description: Emitted when a color token is selected. The detail contains the selection metadata and requested clipboard text; this event does not confirm clipboard success.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-color-picker>` element browses and selects colors from the available palettes.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Select | Select a color to copy its CSS variable reference. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Focus a color choice. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Select the focused color and copy its CSS variable reference. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
